title: Special Executive Programme In Enterprise Software Development
description: The Special Executive Program in Enterprise Software Development aims to introduce the learner to the concepts of Enterprise system software infrastructure analysis, development and implementation.
longDescription: This program introduces participants to enterprise systems and software, covering critical topics such as reference models, IT infrastructure, and business processes. Learners will explore client/server computing, database systems, and enterprise architecture while gaining insights into ERP and CRM fundamentals. The course also emphasizes business process reengineering, business intelligence, and service-oriented architecture.
courseDetails: Participants will engage with key concepts in enterprise software development, including process analysis, design, and implementation. The curriculum covers middleware, messaging systems, and the role of enterprise content management (ECM). Students will learn practical strategies for applying these technologies to enhance organizational efficiency.
